sources.title: EndoSight AI: Deep Learning-Driven Real-Time Gastrointestinal Polyp ...
sources.snippet: Abstract - Precise and real-time detection of gastrointestinal polyps during endoscopic procedures is crucial for early diagnosis and prevention of colorectal cancer.
